title-proc.eng: Multi-functional machines with PaperCut compatibility

description-proc.eng: OFA IKS is holding this procurement on behalf of the owner municipalities in the OFA cooperation to establish a new framework agreement for multi-function machines (MFP) and associated services. The municipalities have a significant and varying need for printing, copying and scanning. The current machinery consists of both leased and self-owned multi-function machines of varying ages, capacity, functionality and remaining lifetime. At the same time, the municipalities ́s sizes, organisation and patterns of use vary. There is therefore a need for a flexible and future orientated contract that supports both standardisation and local adaptations. The aim of the procurement is to establish a joint framework agreement that gives municipalities access to a predictable, cost efficient, safe and stable operation of the multifunction machines. The contract shall facilitate for gradual replacement and modernisation of the machinery, at the same time that the existing systems can be continued where appropriate. The municipalities have already adopted PaperCut as a joint system for secure printing and print out administration. The procurement does not, therefore, include a new print management system. It is a fundamental prerequisite that the offered multi-function machines are fully compatible with PaperCut and can be integrated seamlessly in the contracting authority ́s existing printout environment. For most of the municipalities in Agder, the ICT services are delivered through intermunicipal cooperation or companies, whilst some municipalities still have their own IT environments. This means that ordering routines, approval processes, invoicing and follow-up vary between the individual contracting authorities. Tenderers must, therefore, be able to handle different organisational models within the framework of the agreement. Through the procurement, OFA IKS would like to establish a long term and sustainable delivery model that safeguards the municipalities ́ need for quality, security, flexibility and good total economy. The procurement shall contribute to better management of the machinery, reduced administrative load, effective use of resources and relevant environmental gains. 2. Description of the assignment The assignment includes the delivery of multi-function machines and the accompanying services to municipalities and entities included in the framework agreement. The delivery shall cover the need for printing, copy and scanning at different types of locations and organisations, from smaller administrative units to larger environments with a high document volume and advanced function needs. The contract includes, among other things: hire of multi-function machines delivery and replacement of equipment installation, configuration and commissioning service and maintenance technical support and user follow-up. ongoing consultancy services and agreement follow-up. reporting and management information The tenderer shall offer a flexible delivery model that supports gradual renewal of the machinery and ensures stable operation in periods where new and existing systems must function parallel. The contracting authority reserves the right to procure used multi-function machines by the supplier, or others where appropriate. We request an overall delivery with particular emphasis on quality, service, security, flexibility and life cycle costs. Further requirements for functionality, services, service levels and documentation are in the tender documentation ́s other parts.

The assembly station is for connecting fibre array units (FAUs) to an optical chip. The type of connection will be edge coupling using waveguides loops for alignment but if necessary, the alignment can also be performed either using the light source on the chip (if it exists) or by using an external light source and connecting two FAUs, one on each side of the chip. The purpose of the photonic wafer probe station is to characterise the quality of photonic integrated circuits (PICs). It should be possible to characterise both optical and electrical performance. For the optical characterisation, the main coupling in/out technique will be through grating couplers, but the equipment should be possible to be configured also for edge coupling to component facets in a grove on the wafer. In this case, different holders and fibres may be needed. The electrical characteristics are to be characterised both in DC as well as RF up to 40GHz using probe and/or probe cards. The system shall support research, development, process qualification, and routine characterization activities within DTU Nano's advanced fabrication facility.

description-proc.eng: Background This competition is being held under the dynamic purchasing system 'Dynamic purchasing system for user controlled personal assistance'. The competition is for a concrete call-off under the scheme, where Tolga municipality invites qualified tenderers to submit a tender for the delivery and administration of a BPA scheme. The aim of the call-off is to cover a limited and concrete need for BPA services. Further details on the assignment ́s content, scope and price model are given below. Description of the assignment Tolga municipality needs an external supplier who can take over the overall responsibility for a user-controlled personal assistance scheme for a 14-year-old girl with extensive assistance needs. The aim is to ensure the user and her family a safe, stable and predictable service, while the municipality receives a robust organisation of the scheme with clear placement of responsibility, ongoing follow-up and the necessary reporting. The procurement is for a complete BPA delivery within a scope of up to 250 hours per week, based on the current decision and the current rota needs. The stated number of hours is calculated from the actual rota, which currently consists of the following guards: 07.00-19.00: 1 assistant, 07.00-14.30: 1 assistant, 14.00-21.30: 1 assistant and 21.15-07.15: 1 assistant. The tenderer shall organise, staff and follow-up the scheme as a total delivery, including safeguarding staffing, training, work manager support, rota planning, daily follow-up of assistants, handling temporary staff needs and employer responsibility. There are currently approx. seven man-labour years connected to the scheme. The current staffing consists of four permanent employees and one year temporary staff, in addition to the hire from a temporary staff agency and some temporary staff and some temporary staff. Employees who want this shall be offered a transition of employment relationships from the municipality to the chosen tenderer. The municipality assumes that the tenderer must be able to take over an established service in a way that ensures stability in the transition phase and facilitates the continuation of relevant competence and manpower. The scheme shall function stable over time, with a permanent organised assistant team, sufficient back-up manpower and the ability to handle absences without this affecting the user's everyday life and safety. The assignment includes not only the delivery of hours, but also the responsibility to ensure a sustainable and well-functioning BPA scheme suitable for the user ́s concrete needs. The hours shall be used to cover the need for personal assistance for daily tasks, including personal care and self-care, general leisure activities and daily household assignments. Furthermore, the hours shall be used for simple health services. The hours will not be used for other assignments than those listed above. The municipality will emphasise that the tenderer can provide a comprehensive and coordinated service with a good understanding of work with youth, close cooperation with the family and good interaction with the municipality. The need for services will be continually assessed and the services can be changed or terminated in line with changes in the user ́s help needs. The hours awarded must be used within each calendar year and cannot be transferred to later years. The allocated hours shall as a starting point be used within the municipality ́s borders. The hours can be used for journeys that can be carried out within the employees ́ ordinary working hours. The hours can also be used for domestic and international journeys, provided that this has been clarified and approved by the municipality in advance, as well as by the employees who will participate in the journey. Price The price is given by the municipality as an hourly rate including other costs. The actual hourly rate for the service is NOK 525,- per hour. Prices can be regulated annually after the first contract year. The price regulation shall follow SSB KPI, and the regulation date is set to 1 January.

title-proc.eng: Project "Eclipse: Open Registry Security Gateway for Open VSX"

description-proc.deu: Dieser Dienstleistungsvertrag betrifft die FOSS-Komponente „Eclipse Open VSX“ und die zugehörige technische Spezifikation Eclipse SCINTX und umfasst die Arbeiten, die zur Fertigstellung einer funktionalen Referenzimplementierung der Spezifikation erforderlich sind. Diese soll den Weg für ein offenes Ökosystem ebnen, in dem heterogen betriebene Repositorys mit Plug-ins für integrierte Entwicklungsumgebungen (IDE), die mit der VS-Code-Architektur kompatibel sind, von unabhängigen externen Sicherheitsdienstleistern gescannt und überprüft werden können. Um dies zu erreichen, müssen die in der offenen Spezifikation SCINTX festgelegten funktionalen Anforderungen untersucht werden, um eine Anwendungsprogrammierschnittstelle (API) und eine Systemarchitektur zu entwerfen, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen, wobei für die Implementierungsdetails gegebenenfalls auf bestehende offene Spezifikationen und FOSS-Komponenten zurückgegriffen wird; anschließend ist der Entwurf in ein einsatzfähiges Softwaresystem und eine Konfiguration nach dem aktuellen Stand der Technik in diesem Bereich umzusetzen. Die Arbeit umfasst zudem die Untersuchung der öffentlichen APIs zweier häufig genutzter offener, freier Sicherheits-Scanning-Dienste, um für jeden von ihnen beispielhaft einen anbieterspezifischen Adapter innerhalb des für das Gateway entworfenen Architekturmodells zu implementieren. Schließlich soll ein Software Development Kit (SDK) erstellt werden, um die Erstellung von Adaptern für weitere Drittanbieter und Integrationen zu erleichtern. Diese Arbeit zielt darauf ab, die Sicherheit der Lieferkette der FOSS-Infrastruktur sowie der Softwareindustrie im Allgemeinen zu erhöhen. Dort werden häufig Plug-ins von Drittanbietern verwendet, um Software-IDEs um produktive Funktionen zu erweitern; diese können jedoch aufgrund des ihnen gewährten Zugriffs auf Ressourcen der Entwicklungsumgebung auch als Angriffsvektoren missbraucht werden und somit weit mehr gefährden als nur die Systeme, mit denen sie unmittelbar in Berührung kommen.
description-proc.eng: This service agreement concerns the FOSS component "Eclipse Open VSX" and the associated technical specification Eclipse SCINTX, covering the work needed to complete a functional reference implementation of the specification which is intended to pave the road for an open ecosystem where heterogenously operated repositories of plug-ins for integrated development environments (IDE) that are compatible with the VS Code architecture can be scanned and verified by independent third-party security service-providers. Achieving this entails studying the functional requirements specified by the open specification SCINTX, in order to design an application programming interfaces (API) and a system architecture that realizes these requirements, relying on existing open specifications and FOSS components for the implementation details where applicable, then implementing the design into a usable software system and configuration as per the state-of-the-art in the field. The work also entails studying the public APIs of two commonly used open, free security-scanning services in order to implement a provider-specific adapter for each of them as an example, within the architectural model designed for the gateway. Finally, a software-development kit (SDK) is to be produced, in order to facilitate the creation of adapters for more third-party providers and integrations. This work is intended to increase the security of the supply chain of FOSS infrastructure, and of the software industry in general, where third-party plug-ins are often used to add productive functionality to software IDEs, but can also be abused as attack vectors due to the access they are granted to development environment resources, thus threatening much more than the systems they immediately touch.

title-proc.eng: Project "anndataR: Native R access to the standard single-cell data format"

description-proc.deu: Dieser Dienstleistungsvertrag betrifft die FOSS-Bibliothek „anndataR“ und umfasst die Arbeiten, die erforderlich sind, um diese R-Implementierung der Bioinformatik-Bibliothek mit der neuesten Ausgabe der Referenzimplementierung in Einklang zu bringen. Zu diesem Zweck muss eine Lückenanalyse durchgeführt werden, um die Abweichungen zwischen der aktuellen Implementierung und der neuesten Ausgabe der Referenzimplementierung zu ermitteln. Anschließend müssen Untersuchungen durchgeführt werden, um die beste Methode zur Implementierung der fehlenden Funktionalität im Rahmen der definierten Möglichkeiten und des Programmierparadigmas der Sprache R sowie ihres Ökosystems aus Bibliotheken und Modulen zu ermitteln. Darüber hinaus sind Forschungs- und Entwurfsarbeiten erforderlich, um Lösungen für verschiedene Probleme und Einschränkungen zu entwickeln, die bereits in der bestehenden Implementierung identifiziert wurden. Dazu werden die von Nutzer*innen eingereichten relevanten Problemberichte untersucht und die vorgeschlagenen Lösungen verglichen, um im jeweiligen Fall die beste auszuwählen und umzusetzen. Zudem erfordert die Optimierung und Verbesserung der Leistung der Bibliothek, die bei jedem Durchlauf riesige Datenmengen verarbeitet, eine Profilierung der resultierenden Implementierung und die Messung ihrer Leistung, um Engpässe zu identifizieren und anschließend Lösungen zu deren Beseitigung zu entwerfen. Schließlich gewährleistet der Entwurf und die Implementierung von CI/CD-Tests die kontinuierliche Gültigkeit und Konformität mit zukünftigen Versionen der Referenzimplementierung. Das übergeordnete Ziel dieser Arbeit ist die Pflege einer Infrastruktur aus FOSS-Komponenten, die zur Nutzung großer Datensätze dient, welche entscheidende Bausteine im Bereich der Bioinformatik darstellen, indem diese hinsichtlich ihrer Funktionen und Leistung stets auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik gehalten wird.
description-proc.eng: This service agreement concerns the FOSS‌ library "anndataR", covering the work needed to bring this implementation in R of the bioinformatics library up to compliance with the most recent edition of the reference implementation. To achieve this, a gap analysis must be performed to identify the deviation between the current implementation and the most recent edition of the reference implementation. Research must then be conducted to arrive at the best method to implement the lacking functionality within the defining capabilities and programming paradigm of the R language and its ecosystem of libraries and modules. Moreover, research and design work is required to devise solutions to several issues and limitations that are already identified within the existing implementation, by examining the relevant issue reports submitted by users, and comparing the proposed solutions in order to select the best in each case and implement it. Additionally, optimising and improving the performance of the library, which processes huge amounts of data in each run, entail profiling the resulting implementation and measuring its performance to identify bottlenecks, then design solutions to mitigate them. Finally, the design and implementation of CI/CD tests ensures the continuous validity and compliance with future editions of the reference implementation. The overall aim of this work is to maintain FOSS infrastructure components used to utilise the large datasets that are critical building blocks in the field of bioinformatics, by keeping it updated as per the state-of-the-art in the field, in terms of capabilities and performance.

description-proc.eng: 1. The objective is to select a technically suitable and commercially viable platform, considering the DBW solution, vehicle cost and availability, and integration risk. The DBW system will support autonomous-driving research using ROS 2 and Autoware on FMCI's NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Orin platform. International suppliers are eligible to tender, subject to applicable Irish and EU import, tax, safety and procurement requirements. The vehicle is not part of the contract awarded under this RFT. Following contract award, FMCI will procure the nominated vehicle platform separately in accordance with its procurement obligations. 3. Required Tender Outcome The successful tenderer shall provide a complete solution enabling FMCI to: * source a compatible right-hand-drive battery-electric passenger vehicle in Ireland; * electronically control steering, propulsion, braking, gear selection and direction indicators using the vehicle OEM actuation systems; * retain safe and immediate manual-driver override; * provide an emergency-stop and defined fail-safe architecture; * perform controlled low-speed operation using a remote operator controller; * communicate with the DBW system from the NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Orin using a documented ROS 2 interface; * install, deploy and maintain the supplier-provided ROS 2 interface on AArch64/ARM64; * commission and accept the DBW installation using objective functional and software-interface tests; and * operate and maintain the system without undisclosed mandatory subscriptions, software dependencies or unsupported proprietary interfaces. The services to be procured comprise permanent security guarding of the EMA premises, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, delivered by a dedicated on-site team consisting of a security operational manager and assistant, shift supervisors and security guards, including reception, access control, screening of persons, mail and luggage, patrols, control room operation, incident response and security administration support; additional ad hoc guarding for events and for periods of increased activity; rental of security screening equipment (X-ray scanners, walk-through metal detectors, mobile fencing, portable CCTV) with trained operators, for events; supply of security consumables and devices (access cards, lanyards, card holders and similar items); and security emergency services: rapid deployment of additional guarding capacity and equipment in case of a security crisis. The contract will take the form of a multiple framework contract in cascade, for an initial duration of two years, renewable twice for one year (four years in total). The estimated value given in this notice is indicative and non-binding and may change in the contract notice. Points which interested economic operators may wish to consider in advance of the publication of the contract notice: Services must be delivered in accordance with Dutch legislation on private security (Wet particuliere beveiligingsorganisaties en recherchebureaus), including the authorisation of the company and the licensing and screening of all guarding personnel. Tenderers must hold the relevant authorisation at the time of submission. A change of contractor may give rise to a transfer of undertaking under Dutch law and the applicable collective labour agreement for the private security sector. Information on the personnel currently deployed will be made available with the tender documents so that all tenderers can assess this on an equal basis. The contract places strong emphasis on the recruitment, training, retention and development of the security team, on service levels measured through key performance indicators, and on sustainability in the supply of consumables. The award will be based on the best price-quality ratio with a predominant weighting for quality. The contract will be concluded on the basis of EMA's standard framework contract, with special conditions adapted to security services, including a liability regime tailored to the Dutch security market. The tender documents will be published in English. A site visit will be organised during the submission period. The contract notice and the complete procurement documents will be published in the Official Journal of the European Union and on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal. Economic operators interested in this procedure are invited to register on the Funding & Tenders Portal, to obtain a Participant Identification Code (PIC) if they do not already have one, and to subscribe to the procedure once published in order to receive notifications. The launch date indicated in this notice is an estimate. This prior information notice does not constitute a call for competition and does not oblige EMA to launch the procedure; no contact with economic operators will take place outside the official publication channels.
